newsitem.title: USA: Bank United gives pricing on tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Bank United gives pricing on tender offer.

text.p: Bank United Corp said Friday that the total consideration to be paid per $1,000 principal amount of its 8.05 percent senior notes due May 15, 1998 will be $1,054.83, assuming a payment date of May 8, 1997.
The total consideration includes the tender offer consideration of $1,049.83 for each $1,000 principal amount plus a consent payment of $5.00 per $1,000 principal amount.
The company said the expiration date of the offer is May 7, unless extended.

It said that as of Friday morning, $114.5 million in aggregate principal amount of notes, representing about 99.6 percent of the $115 million notes outstanding, had been tendered and consents provided.
